AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE 2015 GENERAL ELECTION ORDINANCE FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA; TO PROVIDE FOR HALL COUNTY ELECTIONS DEPARTMENT TO HANDLE THE 2015 GENERAL ELECTION AND 2015 SPECIAL ELECTION; TO PROVIDE FOR THE APPOINTMENT OF ELECTION OFFICIALS, INCLUDING THE ELECTION SUPERINTENDENT, THE CHIEF REGISTRAR, THE ABSENTEE BALLOT CLERK, THE CUSTODIAN OF VOTING MACHINES, THE CHIEF POLL MANAGER, THE ASSISTANT POLL MANAGERS, AND THE DEPUTY REGISTRAR; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia is authorized by Ast. IX, § I, ] Ul of the Constitution of the State of Georgia of 1983, and pursuant to O.C.G.A.
4: The 2015 General Election Ordinance for the Town of Clermont, Georgia is hereby amended as provided by this ordinance.
5: The Town of Clermont, Georgia will conduct a General Election on Tuesday, November 3, 2015, from 7:00 a.m. until 7:00 p.m., with the place of said election being in the Concord Baptist Church, 640 Main Street, Clermont, Georgia 30527 for the public positions up for election in the General Election.
6:
(A) The following persons are hereby appointed to act as election officials for the 2015

General Election:

Election Superintendent As appointed by Council resolution.

Chief Registrar As appointed by Council resolution.

Absentee Ballot Clerk As appointed by Council resolution.

Voting Machines Custodian As appointed by Council resolution.

Chief Poll/Precinct As appointed by Council resolution. Manager

Assistant Poll/Precinct As appointed by Council resolution. Manager

Assistant Poll/Precinct As appointed by Council resolution. Manager

Assistant Registrar As appointed by Council resolution.

(B) The Town Council by resolution can appoint the Hall County Elections Department to handle the 2015 municipal elections at any point during the election process.

(C) The administrative office of the Town of Clermont, Georgia is hereby declared to be one of the offices of the Election Superintendent for the purpose of candidates qualifying for the offices open for election as provided by Ordinance, and also as an office of the Absentee Ballot Clerk. The Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, by proper resolution passed in a regularly scheduled public meeting of the Town Council, is authorized to set the compensation that each election official shall receive. The offices of the Hall County Elections Department can also serve as election offices of the Town for the 2015 elections.
7:
If any paragraph, subparagraph, sentence, clause, phrase, or any portion of this Ordinance should be declared invalid or unconstitutional by any court of competent jurisdiction or if the provisions of any part of this Ordinance is applied to any particular situation or set of circumstances shall be declared invalid or unconstitutional, such invalidity shall not be construed to effect the portions of this Ordinance not so held to be invalid, or the application of this Ordinance to other circumstances not so held to be invalid. It is hereby declared to be the intent of the Town Council of the Town of Clermont to provide for separate and divisible parts, and it does hereby adopt any and all parts hereof as may not be held invalid for any reason.
